claim_text: R4 makes the §3.1 #2 World-State-Transition complement explicit, reuse-first, read-and-report (zero DI mutation). PART A — world_state.py: a unified claim contract <S, do(a), delta-s-hat, W, F>. validate_wsts() checks well-formedness AND Pearl-types the intervention — causal_admissible is True only when the intervention is do-typed; an observe-typed tuple is valid as description but flagged NOT causal-admissible (P(S'|do(a)) != P(S'|a); conditioning != causation) — the formal device that stops an association from satisfying an Induction/Specificity causal claim. wsts_from_claim() projects an existing claim record's dispersed fields (expected_outcome_if_h1/h0, observable_at, observed_outcome) into the WSTS view without mutation (inferred fields tagged), unifying what cascade-sim / squidiff / the claim-record schema already carry scattered. calibration_datum() emits the NATIVE Test-4 datum (stated_confidence, observed_label) via compute_ece.outcome_to_label. PART B — answer_pipeline.tool_universe_directive(): when Path B triggers, the bundle now carries an explicit Tool Universe directive (PubMed_search_articles / EuropePMC_search / tooluniverse-literature-deep-research + merge-back through the SAME composite-auditor gate, ADR-0022) and required_next instructs the agent to run it — Tool Universe is NAMED + actionable, not a silent stub. Verified offline NO-SPEND: do-typed validates + causal-admissible; observe-typed valid-but-not-causal; malformed fails; the real 143000 minimal-set claim projects to a do-WSTS; a resolved record emits (0.95, 1.0); directive emits the MCP query; both files compile under -W error::DeprecationWarning.
